item.title: GitHub Actions submodule checkout failed on a private submodule
item.description: GitHub Actions submodule checkout failed is a credential message rather than a git one: the outer repository clones cleanly and only the submodule fetch stops. The credential the action configured is scoped to the repository running the workflow, and a submodule usually lives somewhere else.

item.title: GitHub Actions cache: keys, scopes and the limits that decide a hit
item.description: A GitHub Actions cache is a keyed, immutable archive scoped to one repository, capped at 10 GB by default and removed after 7 days without a read. Almost everything people call a caching bug is one of those four words arriving without a log line to announce it.
